items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: Fregassof was the one that changed more.

ctx.x: Yeah, more Dixieland style in India. Alcon didn't change so much, but Fregassof was the one that changed more.
What about George Lewis's band there? Do they play the same as they played Preservation Hall?

items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: Both Ervin Alcon and Fregassoll played more modern than they usually do.

ctx.x: What did that band play like?
Well, it was kind of a modern Dixman band, I would say. Both Ervin Alcon and Fregassoll played more modern than they usually do.
Did they sound like Eddie Connan's band, or did they sound like Turk Martin?
